payload.title: Lesson-reachable cloud connection: pre-warm and emulator fallback
payload.description:
Pre-warmed task for lessons with needs: cloud. Acceptance, with a mock backend that starts in 30 s:
- PathPage calls warm() when the current or next lesson has needs: cloud, and the lesson calls it on open; never for every Learn page
- c1/11 offers [Run it here] after 20 s on the emulator with the recorded image
- the pass check is the same either way
- the output label says where the program ran ('Ran on the RISC-V machine in your browser')
- offline: cloud lesson plays from the recorded answer and the emulator with the honest message
